chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from an-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Aban from a man from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) said: 'The father draws the manumission (wala') when he is manumitted.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the right of manumission (wala') for a father when his child is freed?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) clarifies that the right of 'wala'' (patronage) follows the father rather than the mother, establishing a key principle in Shia jurisprudence regarding inheritance of manumission rights. It underscores the patriarchal lineage's role in legal status, ensuring that the patronage of a freed slave remains within the father's lineage for inheritance purposes. This ruling is foundational in discussions of 'itq' (emancipation) and its economic and social implications in early Islamic society.
